arms.raw_model: Question only; local backends have no Open Agronomy system instruction. App-server transports retain their declared text-only transport control.
arms.baseline: Production Open Agronomy kernel and answer handling without structured field context, retrieval, tools, evidence intervention, or verifier.
arms.kernel_field_context: Baseline plus exactly crop_current, region_text, province_state, and management_notes when present; no retrieval, tools, evidence intervention, or verifier.
arms.agronomic_rag: Core text-agent path with governed retrieval, evidence fabric, intervention policy, verifier when configured, and answer post-processing. Expected live adapters are traced but not executed by this interface.

claim_boundaries: This interface measures response generation and governed retrieval behaviour, not live public-adapter execution.
A textual source or tool mention is never evidence that a provider was called.
The benchmark contains project-authored scenarios and is not an estimate of the distribution of real grower questions.
Automated semantic judging is triage, not independent agronomist validation.
No single composite score is permitted across semantic, retrieval, lineage, and objective calculation lanes.
